verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community tip about tuning or disabling the refresh interval during bulk indexing (elastic-comm-6), which implies a bulk-indexing workflow. Serverless docs note that resources scale up automatically during ingest spikes (elastic-docs-33). Nothing in the pack documents a bulk API, throughput at millions of documents, or async task tracking for indexing completion. missing for 10: first-party Bulk API documentation, async task/status tracking for indexing jobs, evidence of throughput at million-document scale, independent hands-on corroboration.
